sources.name: Road blocks, closures and detours
sources.access: Existing county-published public service connection; anonymous /query only in this app, credentials omitted. No new service or permissions.
sources.identity: Layer ID + GlobalID; complete ObjectID inventory reconciled in batches of 200
sources.comparison: 479 records and all selected attribute/geometry revisions matched the official public view on 2026-10-17. These include history, not 479 active closures.
sources.crs: Request and verify EPSG:4326; preserve missing geometry as an information gap, no inferred road shape
sources.freshness: Query age >7 min marked stale. Failed/partial updates retain prior snapshot and show failure. Old per-record dates remain visible. No date/absence/flag is a road-open inference.
sources.transport: One bounded retry for transient connection/server errors. No browser local-network permission or TLS exception required.
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS and Road Maintenance; publisher item owned by chuvang. Backup owner and source-status definitions to confirm.

sources.name: Watches, warnings and advisories, current layer 1
sources.access: Public; direct browser POST queries; no credentials
sources.coverage: Returned polygons intersecting Fresno, Madera, Merced, Kings and Tulare counties
sources.identity: cap_id plus issuance; content/geometry changes also notify
sources.query_crs: EPSG:4326; output explicitly requested in EPSG:4326
sources.semantics: Agency hazard products, not observed water levels or inundation depths. Query success is not an independent publisher heartbeat.
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS maintainer to be assigned

sources.name: TIGERweb State_County county polygons, January 1, 2026 vintage
sources.processing: Byte-identical copy of the validated pilot boundary file. No simplification or repairs. Query adapter copies coordinates and orients rings for Esri polygon convention.
sources.validation: county-validation.json; five valid input geometries and valid union
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS maintainer to be assigned

sources.name: ArcGIS Maps SDK for JavaScript 5.1, Calcite, gray/imagery basemaps and World Terrain
sources.access: Public CDN and basemap endpoints; Esri license/service terms apply
sources.display_crs: Web Mercator 2D and global SceneView; no measurements or elevation arithmetic
sources.attribution: Rendered by the ArcGIS map attribution component
sources.imagery_semantics: Historical basemap imagery, not a current observation.

sources.name: NWPS gauge metadata and stage/flow series
sources.access: Public direct browser GET; no credentials
sources.coverage: Nine curated Fresno County river and San Joaquin boundary-reach watchpoints; see river-watchlist.json for inclusion roles and excluded neighboring sites.
sources.identity: Uppercase NWPS lid; samples keyed by validTime within observed or forecast series
sources.units_datum: Native primary/secondary series units; explicit stage or flow conversion for comparisons. Gauge datum text displayed without inferring reference units. No elevation/depth arithmetic.
sources.publisher_update_interval: Station and forecast dependent; not guaranteed by application polling
sources.freshness_rules: Prototype: observation at most 2 hours old; forecast issue at most 24 hours old; successful station query at most 7 minutes old; source out-of-service/not-current flags suppress cues
sources.unknowns: -999 and -9999 numeric sentinels, year-0001 times, absent series and absent categories remain unknown. The nine retained live candidates lacked usable flood thresholds at the 2026-10-17 check.
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS with NWS/operator validation; contacts to be assigned

sources.name: NFHL Flood Hazard Zones
sources.coverage: Selected hazard polygons intersecting Fresno County (Census GEOID 06019), using a client-side geometry display filter at local zoom. Whole source polygons retained, not clipped; no completeness or exposure claim.
sources.identity: FLD_AR_ID with DFIRM_ID and SOURCE_CIT; object IDs are service query IDs
sources.timestamps: Planning reference. Effective study dates must be checked in FEMA Map Service Center; no event forecast or observation time implied.
sources.crs: Native EPSG:4269 NAD83; SDK projects for display
sources.filter: SFHA_TF = 'T' OR ZONE_SUBTY LIKE '%0.2%' OR FLD_ZONE = 'D'
sources.drawing: Shown at 1:100000 or closer; 1% special flood hazard, 0.2% annual chance and undetermined D, separate from gauge cues. Other zones filtered.
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS; FEMA remains authoritative publisher
sources.display_filter: FeatureLayerView.filter: Fresno County polygon projected to the view CRS, spatialRelationship intersects. Display simplification can affect border precision.

sources.name: WorldElevation3D Terrain3D
sources.access: Public elevation service; Esri service terms apply
sources.coverage: Global compilation; no claim of survey-grade county accuracy
sources.crs: EPSG:3857 horizontal; source describes orthometric meters from multiple datasets
sources.resolution: Variable source resolution; service describes global range 1000 m to 50 cm, not a guarantee at any Fresno location
sources.processing: SDK ground display, no vertical exaggeration, hydrologic conditioning, terrain derivatives, viewshed or water surface
sources.timestamps: Static/mixed acquisition dates; not event observation or live terrain
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS maintainer to be assigned

sources.name: Caltrans CCTV camera catalog and publisher media
sources.access: Public direct HTTPS GET with CORS; no credentials, proxy or media archive
sources.coverage: Eight manually curated Fresno river-crossing approaches; see camera-watchlist.json. Madera and Tulare boundary approaches explicitly labeled. Direct river visibility unverified.
sources.identity: District + index, checked against expected source locationName and stored coordinates. Duplicate, missing, renamed or moved records are unavailable until reviewed.
sources.crs: EPSG:4326 WGS84 source lon/lat. Reported camera elevation is unused.
timestamps: Catalog recordEpoch (record change, not capture time)
Image Last-Modified response header (file time only)
Application catalog check and image load times
On-image timestamp retained visually; no OCR or inferred capture date
sources.publisher_update_interval: Catalog as necessary; selected images report one-minute update frequency. Video availability and latency vary.
sources.app_refresh: Catalog every 5 minutes when tab visible; one selected image at max(60s, publisher interval) when panel/tab visible; video on demand
sources.freshness_rules: Catalog overdue after 7 minutes; image file old after max(5 minutes, 3 published intervals); future/absent file times unknown; unsuccessful loads explicitly flagged
sources.visual_review: 2026-10-17: five selected images showed roadway conditions. Indices 24 (Valley Children's Blvd), 53 (Herndon Avenue) and 35 (Route 201/Kingsburg) served outage graphics despite in-service flags and recent file times. Dated manual warnings are stored in camera-watchlist.json; a maintainer must recheck before clearing. No automatic image-content detection.
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS to be assigned; Caltrans controls cameras and feeds

sources.name: MRMS radar base reflectivity time imagery
sources.access: Direct public browser requests; no credentials
sources.coverage: CONUS frames; regional context not clipped to county
sources.identity: objectid used only to lock an individual available raster; idp_validtime is source frame time
sources.units: Rendered RGB echo image; reflectivity dBZ. No raw pixel dBZ or rain-rate conversion.
sources.crs: Publisher Web Mercator EPSG:3857, displayed in shared MapView/SceneView
sources.legend: Qualitative echo-color key; linked official NWS numerical scale. Publisher RGB bands have no usable dBZ legend in this service metadata.
sources.freshness: Latest frame <=20 min; successful check <=7 min; failed/old checks hide overlay. Historical choice is explicitly labeled and stays selected until unavailable or changed.

sources.name: WPC quantitative precipitation forecasts
sources.access: Direct public browser FeatureLayer and bounded metadata queries
sources.coverage: Publisher national product displayed across Fresno and upstream context; no county clip or basin average
sources.identity: product plus issue_time/start_time/end_time and QPF band; object IDs not treated as stable products
sources.units: Inches liquid equivalent, including melted snow/ice. Source polygon value retained.
sources.crs: Native publisher GCS_Sphere_EMEP sphere; ArcGIS SDK projection for display, no area calculations
sources.drawing: Same six blue groups for every period: 0.01-<0.25, 0.25-<0.50, 0.50-<1, 1-<2, 2-<5, 5+ inches. Below 0.01 omitted; blank is not assumed zero.
sources.freshness: Single coherent cycle required; issue age <=24h, valid period not ended, check <=7 min. Failed/old/mixed cycles hidden.
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS with NWS interpretation to be assigned

sources.publisher: California DWR CDEC; operator reports from USBR and USACE
sources.name: Millerton and Pine Flat reservoir series
sources.access: Public Node collector; source does not supply browser CORS at check. Atomic same-origin JSON output, no credentials.
sources.coverage: MIL and PNF only; no complete upstream reservoir inventory
sources.units_datum: FEET, AF, CFS checked against configured metrics. Elevation datum unspecified in feed; no datum conversion or water surface. Daily report dates preserved.
sources.crs: CDEC station metadata lon/lat stored as WGS84 EPSG:4326; 2 input points, 2 retained, no repair/derived geometry
sources.processing: Five-day bounded requests; sensor rows reconciled with per-series input/accepted/rejected counts. Future/sentinel/flagged/wrong-unit rows not valid. Conflicting duplicates fail station update. Retain last successful station on fetch failure.
sources.cadence: MIL daily; PNF hourly. Collector target 15 min; browser snapshot check 1 min. GitHub schedule/deployment may delay.
sources.release_meaning: MIL sensor85 river outlet release,71 spill,23 total outflow shown separately. PNF sensor23 reported outflow. No scheduled release ingestion or inferred river routing.
sources.freshness: Snapshot age >45min warns; hourly measurements >3h and daily >72h marked old. Newer missing records shown alongside last valid reading. Prototype rules, not operator triggers.
sources.maintenance_owner: County GIS collector owner and backup to be assigned

exercise: Explicit ?exercise=1 disables live alerts/gauges/cameras/radar/QPF/reservoir reads. Area-watch has isolated fictional rain/gauge/release fixtures; basemap, terrain and FEMA remain reference context.
privacy: Only public boundaries, station identifiers/locations, source metadata and code. No private operational assets, reviews, rosters, fleet locations or credentials.

areaWatch.qpf: Layer 9 WPC Days 1-3, fixed EPSG:4326 point intersections, highest returned label; no basin average. Missing polygons remain unknown.
areaWatch.associations: Explicit named-reach source groups; no routing, inundation or staging polygons.
